args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Itinerary (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple pieces for beach days and water activities)
- Sunscreen (high SPF for tropical sun protection)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and shopping)
- Camera (to capture memories)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach towel and beach bag
- Snorkeling equipment (if not renting)
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Light rain jacket
- Formal outfit for Luau experience
- Water shoes for kayaking

Additional Recommendations:
- Sunglasses and hat
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Portable charger
- Reusable water bottle
